topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I hadn't been up to the attic since we moved in, deciding it was best to let things settle first. Today, though, a curious urge drew me up those creaky stairs. The light is dim in there, and the dust motes float like whispers. As I stepped in, my breath caught. The space was not empty as we had assumed; it housed rows of old trunks and boxes, their surfaces coated with a fine layer of time. My fingers paused over the latch of the nearest trunk, hesitating. Part of me wanted to open it, to uncover the stories of those who lived here before us. Another part yearns to retreat, to close the door on the past and keep our home just for us. What should I do?
